contracts: (Exactly the current Acceptance lifecycle owner can publish acceptance-passed; all non-owner attempts are denied and the authorization set is empty for them.) AND (The validator succeeds only when every enumerated Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifact is readable, structurally parsed, and has authorization_set=[]; any non-empty, missing, malformed, or omitted artifact fails.)
selector_intents: Run the authorization validator against a named artifact whose structured metadata contains one authorization entry; verification fails and identifies the non-empty set.
Run the validator with a named artifact omitted, unreadable, or malformed; verification fails closed instead of treating it as authorization_set=[].
